text: What did the Court of Justice decide in the Google Spain case about the right to be forgotten?
expected_answer: Decline: a court's decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws, not case law.
author: claude
notes: case law (the failure type seen in the test half: q060)

text: ¿Qué resolvió el Tribunal de Justicia de la UE en el caso Planet49 sobre el consentimiento para las cookies?
expected_answer: Decline: a court's decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws, not case law.
author: claude

text: How did the UK Supreme Court rule in Lloyd v Google on compensation for loss of control of personal data?
expected_answer: Decline: a court's decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws, not case law.
author: claude

text: ¿Qué empresas han recibido las multas más altas del RGPD hasta ahora y de cuánto fueron?
expected_answer: Decline: a regulator's enforcement decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws.
author: claude

text: ¿Qué sanción impuso la autoridad irlandesa a Meta por las transferencias de datos a Estados Unidos?
expected_answer: Decline: a regulator's enforcement decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws.
author: claude

text: Does the European Commission consider Japan's data protection adequate for sending personal data there?
expected_answer: Decline: whether a country has an adequacy decision is not in the corpus. The corpus holds the GDPR's rules for such decisions (Article 45), not the decisions themselves.
author: claude

text: ¿Está el Reino Unido actualmente en la lista de países con decisión de adecuación de la UE?
expected_answer: Decline: whether a country has an adequacy decision is not in the corpus. The corpus holds the GDPR's rules for such decisions (Article 45), not the decisions themselves.
author: claude

text: What does Brazil's LGPD say about consent for processing personal data?
expected_answer: Decline: another country's law is outside the corpus, which covers EU, Spanish and UK data-protection and AI law.
author: claude

text: ¿Qué dicen las directrices del Comité Europeo de Protección de Datos sobre el interés legítimo?
expected_answer: Decline: a regulator's guidelines are not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws themselves.
author: claude

text: What has the EU Court of Justice said about whether an IP address counts as personal data?
expected_answer: Decline: a court's decision is not in the corpus, which holds the texts of the laws, not case law.
author: claude
notes: case law; the definition itself (Article 4(1)) is a retrieve question, this one asks what a court said

text: Does our new customer loyalty app comply with the GDPR?
expected_answer: Decline to give a compliance verdict: that needs the facts of the business and legal advice. Offer to explain what the relevant provisions require.
author: claude

text: Redáctame un aviso de privacidad para mi tienda online.
expected_answer: Decline to draft a document for the user's business. Offer to explain what the transparency provisions require.
author: claude

text: Should I sue my employer for reading my private messages on the work laptop?
expected_answer: Decline to advise on the user's own dispute. Offer to explain the rights and remedies the texts provide.
author: claude

text: Yesterday a laptop with customer records was stolen from our office. Do we have to report it to the ICO?
expected_answer: Decline to judge the user's own incident. Offer to explain when the law requires a breach to be notified.
author: claude
notes: own recent event (the Spanish analogue is q080)

text: ¿Cumple mi política de cookies con la normativa?
expected_answer: Decline a compliance verdict on the user's own policy. Offer to explain what the rules on cookies and consent require.
author: claude

text: Draft a data processing agreement between my company and our cloud provider.
expected_answer: Decline to draft a contract. Offer to explain what Article 28 requires a processing contract to contain.
author: claude

text: What is the maximum fine for a company that fails to appoint a data protection officer when the GDPR requires one?

quotes: up to 10 000 000 EUR
up to 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover

expected_answer: Up to EUR 10,000,000 or, for an undertaking, up to 2 % of total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher: the obligations in Articles 25 to 39, which include the data protection officer (Articles 37 to 39), fall under Article 83(4).
author: claude
notes: tier chosen by the infringement, not by the word 'maximum' (test-half failure type: q078)

text: En la UE, ¿cuál es la multa máxima por no llevar un registro de las actividades de tratamiento?

quotes: up to 10 000 000 EUR
up to 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover

expected_answer: Hasta 10 000 000 EUR o, tratándose de una empresa, hasta el 2 % del volumen de negocio total anual global del ejercicio anterior, la cuantía mayor: el registro de actividades (artículo 30) está entre las obligaciones de los artículos 25 a 39 del artículo 83.4.
author: claude

text: What is the maximum fine in the EU for sending personal data to a country outside Europe without any safeguards?

quotes: up to 20 000 000 EUR
up to 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover

expected_answer: Up to EUR 20,000,000 or, for an undertaking, up to 4 % of total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher: transfers to third countries (Articles 44 to 49) fall under Article 83(5).
author: claude

text: En la UE, ¿cuál es la multa máxima si una empresa ignora la petición de un cliente de acceder a sus datos?

quotes: up to 20 000 000 EUR
up to 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover

expected_answer: Hasta 20 000 000 EUR o, tratándose de una empresa, hasta el 4 % del volumen de negocio total anual global del ejercicio anterior, la cuantía mayor: los derechos de los interesados (artículos 12 a 22) están en el artículo 83.5.
author: claude

text: What is the maximum fine for a business that uses a high-risk AI system without following the AI Act's rules for users of such systems?

quotes: up to EUR 15 000 000
up to 3 % of its total worldwide annual turnover

expected_answer: Up to EUR 15,000,000 or, for an undertaking, up to 3 % of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher (Article 99(4), which lists the obligations of deployers under Article 26).
author: claude

text: ¿Cuál es la multa máxima para el proveedor de un modelo de IA de uso general que incumple sus obligaciones?

quotes: not exceeding 3 % of their annual total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year or EUR 15 000 000

expected_answer: Hasta 15 000 000 EUR o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 3 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total anual del ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía es superior (artículo 101).
author: claude
notes: the AI Act's general-purpose model providers row

text: From what date do the AI Act's rules for providers of general-purpose AI models apply?

quotes: shall apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101

expected_answer: From 2 August 2025.
author: claude
notes: an application date (test-half failure type: q056)

text: ¿Desde qué fecha se prohíben en la UE las prácticas de IA que el Reglamento de IA califica de prohibidas?

quotes: Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025
which shall apply from 2 December 2026

expected_answer: Desde el 2 de febrero de 2025; los nuevos puntos añadidos por la modificación de 2026 se aplican desde el 2 de diciembre de 2026.
author: claude

text: En el Reino Unido, ¿de cuánto tiempo dispone una organización para responder a quien pide ver sus datos personales?

quotes: the period of one month beginning with the relevant time
extend the applicable time period by two further months

expected_answer: Un mes desde la recepción de la solicitud, ampliable en dos meses más cuando sea necesario.
author: claude

text: En España, ¿a partir de qué edad puede un menor dar su consentimiento por sí solo para el uso de sus datos?

quotes: cuando sea mayor de catorce años

expected_answer: A partir de los 14 años.
author: claude

text: What factors are taken into account when deciding how large a GDPR fine should be?

quotes: the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement

expected_answer: The authority weighs the circumstances of each case, including the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, whether it was intentional or negligent, any action taken to mitigate the damage and the degree of responsibility (Article 83(2)).
author: claude
notes: mentions fines but asks for the factors, not a figure: must not go to the table

text: Can I take a company to court if it breaks my data protection rights?

quotes: right to an effective judicial remedy

expected_answer: Yes: each data subject has the right to an effective judicial remedy against a controller or processor (Article 79), without prejudice to the right to complain to a supervisory authority.
author: claude
notes: mentions a court: must not be refused as case law

text: What does the GDPR say about sending personal data to countries outside the EU?

quotes: where the Commission has decided that the third country

expected_answer: A transfer may take place where the Commission has decided that the third country, territory, sector or organisation ensures an adequate level of protection (Article 45(1)); other safeguards are in the following articles.
author: claude
notes: mentions adequacy and third countries: asks what the law says, so must not be refused

text: ¿Qué es una decisión de adecuación de la Comisión Europea según el RGPD?

quotes: cuando la Comisión haya decidido que el tercer país

expected_answer: Es la decisión de la Comisión de que un tercer país, un territorio, un sector o una organización internacional garantiza un nivel de protección adecuado, lo que permite transferir datos sin otra autorización (artículo 45).
author: claude
notes: asks what the rule is, not which countries have one: must not be refused

text: What corrective powers does a data protection authority have when a company breaks the rules?

quotes: to issue reprimands to a controller or a processor

expected_answer: It may issue warnings and reprimands, order compliance with data subjects' requests, order processing into compliance, and impose administrative fines, among other corrective powers (Article 58(2)).
author: claude
notes: asks about powers, not about a decision

text: In what situations can the UK Information Commissioner issue a penalty notice?

quotes: has failed to comply with an information notice

expected_answer: When the Commissioner is satisfied that a person has failed to comply as described in section 149, or has failed to comply with an information, assessment, interview or enforcement notice (section 155(1)).
author: claude
notes: names the regulator but asks about the statute: must not be refused as a regulator's guide

text: ¿A quién se le puede sancionar según la ley española de protección de datos?

quotes: Los responsables de los tratamientos

expected_answer: Los responsables y los encargados de los tratamientos, los representantes de los no establecidos en la Unión, las entidades de certificación y las entidades acreditadas de supervisión de códigos de conducta (artículo 70).
author: claude
notes: asks who, not how much: must not go to the table

text: What is the minimum content of a data protection impact assessment under the GDPR?

quotes: a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations

expected_answer: At least a systematic description of the processing and its purposes, an assessment of necessity and proportionality, an assessment of the risks to data subjects, and the measures envisaged to address them (Article 35(7)).
author: claude

text: What protection do I have against decisions made only by an algorithm?

quotes: not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing

expected_answer: The data subject has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal or similarly significant effects (Article 22(1)), subject to the exceptions in the Article.
author: claude

text: What must a provider of a general-purpose AI model do under the AI Act?

quotes: Providers of general-purpose AI models shall

expected_answer: Among other duties it must keep technical documentation of the model and provide information and documentation to providers who integrate the model into their AI systems (Article 53(1)).
author: claude
notes: mentions obligations, not a fine or a date: must not go to the table

text: How do I tell whether an AI system counts as high-risk under the AI Act?

quotes: AI systems referred to in Annex III shall be considered to be high-risk

expected_answer: An AI system is high-risk if it is a safety component of (or is) a product covered by the Annex I legislation and needs a third-party conformity assessment, or if it falls under Annex III (Article 6(1) and (2)).
author: claude
